related_questions.question: How long will it take for sun poisoning to go away?

text_blocks.snippet: Sun poisoning, a severe form of sunburn, can take anywhere from a few days to several weeks to fully heal. Mild sunburns typically resolve within a week, but sun poisoning, with its more intense symptoms, can last longer, potentially requiring several weeks for complete recovery. The duration depends on the severity of the burn and individual factors like skin type and overall health.

list.title: Sun Poisoning:
list.snippet: Due to its severity, sun poisoning can cause more intense symptoms like blistering, severe pain, swelling, and even fever or dehydration. The healing process can take several weeks or even months, depending on the extent of the damage.

list.title: Factors Affecting Healing Time:
list.snippet: Skin type, sun exposure duration and intensity, altitude, pre-existing conditions, and medications can all influence how long it takes to recover from sun poisoning.

text_blocks.snippet: If you experience severe symptoms like blistering, intense pain, or signs of infection, it's important to seek medical attention.
